suggestions.pitch: Trading 28-year-old Jacobs for Prescott plus Gainwell costs the fewest projected points and adds a 79.7-point RB the unbeaten partner can spare.
Diggs is 32 and scoring above his projection, so selling him now for a tight end costs only a small lineup loss.
Moving Jacobs and the 34-year-old Allen for Prescott and Coker gets younger and keeps the lineup loss modest.
